line: Prabhu, main Aries walon ki wakeel hun, aur ye raha unka 2026 ka hisaab!
Arre, itni lambi list? Ye shikayat hai ya shaadi ka menu?
Suniye na, salary paanch tarikh tak gayab, neend reels mein gayi, aur jo share kharida, wo kharidte hi gir gaya!
Sade Sati chal rahi hai, toh thoda hilna-dulna toh banta hai.
Arey baap re!
Toh gadbad hai re baba!
Arre ghabrao mat, isiliye toh mol-bhaav ho raha hai. Bolo, kya chahiye?
Abhi maza aayega na bhidu!
Toh Prabhu, 2027 mein salary double!
Double nahi, par March-April aur June mein paisa achha aa sakta hai, bas pehle bachat.
Lekin ek second!
Dedh guna? Chaliye sawa guna, final!
Wakeel sahiba, ye sabzi mandi nahi hai.
Toh kam se kam dhaniya toh free kar dijiye!
Accha dhaniya chhodiye, naukri ki suniye na, appraisal teen percent aur upar se boss ke Sunday wale WhatsApp, promotion toh pakka kijiye!
Naye mauke aa sakte hain, bas April-May aur September-October mein gusse mein resign mat karna.
Toh boss ko block kar dein? Sirf Sunday ko?
Block nahi, mute.
Aur har function mein maasi ka sawaal, shaadi kab, aur shaadi ho gayi toh good news kab.
Hey Bhagwan, kya karun main!
Haan, sun raha hun.
Par June ke aakhir se November tak Guru saath hain, rishton mein mithas aa sakti hai.
Aur last demand Prabhu, Sade Sati cancel kar dijiye na.
Wo Shani dev ka vibhag hai, wahan sifaarish nahi, sirf mehnat ka hisaab chalta hai.
Ghabrana mat, Guru bhi saath hain.
Aries dost ko ye bhejo, mahine-wise guide bio ke link mein hai. Agli file, Taurus!
